notes.title: 🔧 Hotfix Update and Next Steps
notes.content: [p]Hey, community![/p][p]As previously announced, the [i]Low and Furious: Baixos de Quebrada[/i] demo has been officially deactivated, marking the end of an important phase of the project. Now, all our focus is on the [b]Early Access version[/b], which better represents the experience we want to deliver. 🚗💨[/p][p]Our first hotfix was ready to launch — in fact, the issue with the mission notification triggering in the wrong place has already been successfully fixed. However, during the final adjustments, we ended up making a bigger change to the core system than expected, which required additional testing and polishing.[/p][p]🎯 We're resolving that now, and soon the hotfix — which has become a small update — will be released with:[/p][list][*][p]Visual improvements[/p][/*][*][p]GPS and mission system optimizations[/p][/*][*][p]New vehicle information[/p][/*][*][p]Music updates[/p][/*][*][p]UI redesigns and much more![/p][/*][/list][p]We truly appreciate your understanding. The next update is packed with improvements and new content, and we can't wait to share it with you all![/p][p]💬 Stay tuned — what’s coming next will take the [i]Low and Furious[/i] experience to a whole new level.[/p]

notes.title: Temporary Bug Identified, Demo Will Be Removed, and Hotfix Incoming!
notes.content:
[p]🛠️ [b]Attention, players![/b][/p][p]We’ve identified a bug when loading a save, where some elements may appear [b]black on the screen[/b].[/p][p]🔧 We're working on a permanent fix, but in the meantime, there’s a [b]simple temporary solution[/b]:[/p][p]✅ Open the in-game phone, go to [b]Graphics Settings[/b], switch the quality level (e.g., from [i]High[/i] to [i]Medium[/i]) and then switch it back.
That should instantly fix the issue![/p][p]Thanks for reporting it and staying with us on this journey! 🙌[/p][hr][/hr][p]🚨 [b]IMPORTANT:[/b]
The [b]demo of [i]Low and Furious: Baixos de Quebrada[/i][/b] will be [b]removed on July 7, 2025[/b].[/p][p]It no longer reflects the current state of the game — since then, we’ve added [b]new mechanics, improvements, and a lot more content[/b].
Huge thanks to everyone who played, gave feedback, and supported us so far.
The project is evolving, and the next phase is coming in hot! 🔥[/p][hr][/hr][p]🔥 [b]Hotfix on the way![/b]
Very soon, we’ll release the [b]first update of the Early Access version[/b], with initial fixes and improvements to make the experience even smoother![/p]

notes.title: DEMO - Update 0.3
notes.content:
[b]Game Update - Low and Furious (Baixos de Quebrada) - DEMO (Windows and Linux)[/b]

[b]Improvements and Updates[/b]

[b]Camera System[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved fixed camera movement
[*] Fixed bug that prevented free camera from working with a controller
[*] Added command to reset free camera position (mouse scroll click or right stick click on controller)
[*] Added option to lock free camera rotation (can be enabled or disabled in the "game" settings on the phone, default is locked)
[*] Several other general improvements
[/list]

[b]Races and AI[/b]

[list]
[*] All races updated
[*] General adjustments to AI racers, still under improvement
[*] General race tweaks
[*] Fixed issue with AI not properly reaching checkpoints
[*] New Time Attack mode added
[*] Adjusted chance percentage of police cars spawning during races
[/list]

[b]Interface and Menus[/b]

[list]
[*] Menus updated with infobox
[*] Fixed template of parts button in the shop
[*] Interface fixes in the shop
[*] Fixed bug preventing main menu options from opening correctly after version v0.2.1
[*] Added screenshot capture when pressing the phone camera button
[/list]

[b]Police Cars and Law Enforcement[/b]

[list]
[*] Adjusted police car settings
[*] HUD now automatically hides when arrested, since the car is turned off
[*] Edited siren sound, now 3D instead of 2D
[*] Fixed police car strobe lights, now blink correctly when activated
[*] Adjusted police arrest area
[/list]

[b]Vehicles and Parts[/b]

[list]
[*] More parts adjusted
[*] Added Portugal and Russia flags for the three available cars
[*] Added new support liner for speakers
[/list]

[b]Optimizations and Graphic Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Optimized some textures
[*] Optimized normal mapping
[*] Updated lighting bake
[*] Optimized some parts of the map
[*] Added more map details
[*] General input adjustments
[*] Removed patchwork from some streets
[*] Loading screen image updated using AI upscaling (original art was made in low resolution)
[*] "Return to menu" option moved to Settings
[*] Updated images for some phone apps
[*] Updated parts of the radar
[*] Added low balance notification
[*] Added new notifications
[*] Fixed some areas missing collision
[*] Build structure changed to improve loading time. The game now loads faster but takes up more disk space.
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]

[list]
[*] Increased volume of traffic vehicle engines
[*] Adjusted volume of police sirens
[*] Added sounds to all three main menu buttons
[*] Menu music now continues during loading screen
[/list]

[b]New Systems[/b]

[list]
[*] Added fuel system:
   [*] New gas station in the rural area
   [*] Toolbox now refuels 10% of the fuel
   [*] System can be disabled in the "game" settings; if you run out of fuel and don’t have a toolbox, use it as well.

[*] Added loan system:
   [*] Focused on emergency situations like running out of money or the beginning of the game
[/list]

[b]Other Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Various other unregistered improvements and fixes
[/list]

[b]Known Issue:[/b]

[list] [*] [b]Issue present since the first version (still unresolved):[/b] Returning to the main menu may cause the game to crash. We recommend saving your progress before performing this action. [/list]

[b]Final Note:[/b]  
This will be the last update for the demo, except for reported bugs. Our focus now is on the main version, and we plan to release the first version in Early Access soon.

We thank everyone who played the demo and helped us with feedback and suggestions. We hope you enjoyed the experience, and if you liked what we're creating, please consider supporting the project by purchasing the game at launch. That will be essential for us to continue improving and expanding Low and Furious. Thank you for the support!


------------------------------------------------------------------------
Temporary information:
We’ve identified a camera bug that occurs when switching cars after the latest update. This issue has already been fixed, and we’ll release a new update by Sunday, April 6, 2025.
The update will also include a new feature: the FOV will now dynamically adjust based on the vehicle’s speed.

[*]     Fixed a bug where a wheel image displayed another part instead.

[*]     Implemented volume adjustments (previously, they were only visual; now, some game volumes can actually be adjusted).
[*]     Added a text prompt on the lock screen informing which button closes the phone.
[*] 
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes and General Adjustments[/b]

[list]
[*]  Fixed a bug where buying a house charged the player twice.
[*]     Updated transactions in the bank app.
[*]     Optimized various scripts.
[*]     Fixed visible holes on the hill.
[*]     Fixed a traffic car texture that appeared white.
[*]     Adjusted details on police cars.
[*]     Fixed a bugged text on a part in the workshop.
[*]     Adjusted some words in the translation.
[*]     Fixed car selling issues.
[*]     Fixed an ID bug in the garage.
[*]     Fixed the ambulance spawn, which appeared with incorrect colors.
[*]     Fixed part ID issues.
[*]     Adjusted normal mapping on some walls.
[*]     Fixed bugs in extra car parts.
[*]     Fixed removed parts still loading in saves.
[*]     On controllers, you can now start the car by pressing up on the D-pad. (We are investigating why the radial menu stopped working with controllers.)
[*]     Fixed a police car without a license plate (ironic, right?).
[*]     Adjusted position selection for paint and window tint menus (some players weren’t noticing the option).
[*]     Changed the default camera to the fixed one to improve controller functionality.
[*]     Fixed the cursor not appearing in the radial menu.
[/list]

[b]Technical Improvements[/b]

 [list]
[*]    Updated FSR and DLSS.
[*]     Adjusted traffic car spawn distance.
[*]     The car sound system will now stop playing when arrested.
[*]     Adjusted fixed NPC spawns in the sound shop and workshop.
[*]     Added a version info display in the main menu.
[*]     The speedometer HUD now hides when the car is turned off.

[b]Other Changes[/b]

[list]

[*]     Made adjustments to the game's music list, now featuring 45 tracks instead of 38. Since we lost track of the exact songs in the demo, there may be new ones. However, if your favorite song is missing, don’t worry! The full version will have all the tracks.

[*]     Changed the texture of a storefront related to the mention above.
[*]     Removed the "Install" button from the store submenu in the demo. (The system is still being implemented. In the demo, this submenu can only be used to view the requirements for installing dependent parts; it is not functional yet.)

The Linux version will remain on 0.1 until we can properly validate 0.2.

notes.title: DEMO - Hotfix #4
notes.content:
[b]Update for Windows and GNU/Linux[/b]

New Feature: Added Toolbox
        📌 When to use? If you don’t want to go to the workshop every time to repair your car.
        🔧 Where to buy? Available at the workshop.
        🚛 Special function: Allows you to call a quick tow truck to restart the car if it falls into the water.
        🛠️ Instant repair: Press 1 to repair the car at any time.
        ♻️ Limited uses: Can be used twice before needing to buy another one.

[b]Fixes and Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] License Plate Validation: The game now checks if the car is registered at the start.
[*] Collectibles: Fixed an issue that allowed players to collect them multiple times.
[*] The message confirming that the game was saved now correctly appears in the mobile profile.
[*] The message confirming that the save was loaded has also been fixed.
[*] Added the "Chase Cam Lag" effect to one of the fixed cameras.
[*] Fixed the cursor not appearing in the house purchase menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera rotated when accessing the purchase menu.
[*] Improved loading saved game.
[*] Achievement Fix: If you already own a house but the achievement was not unlocked, it will now be unlocked automatically.
[/list]

📝 Important Notice: The displayed house price is 10,000, but it is currently charging 20,000. We are investigating the cause.

⚠️ Recommendation: Do not attempt to buy the house with less than 20,000, as the game may also deduct the license plate cost. If this happens, reload your save on the phone to restore progress.
